Each is a virtual stationary obstacle on a schedule that is a keyed hash of (seed, class, id, day), never a draw from a shared stream. Render-only: obstacles shape the visual queue offset and never move a caravan's arrival day. (Code term only: 'market ward'.)

bronze_age.canon_notes: The dark hour must be re-derived from sim day for any obstacle schedule. Whether gates shut at the dark hour is not canon-confirmed. Player-facing wording: 'gates shut at the dark hour', never 'curfew' (medieval civic word). Use 'caravan halts / waystations', never 'coach posts' (R10). Keyed hash in the R9 pattern: xmur3(seed+class+id+day) -> mulberry32 (filigree-1-research.js:54); no draw from W.rng.hist/gen/det (alters the world) or W.rng.amb (index.html:7161; per-frame draws make the view depend on frame rate)

bronze_age.analogue: Caravan strings of pack donkeys and carts spaced IDM-style (large s0 and T, donkey-pace v0). They bunch and queue at gates as a render-only offset, a stateless f(seed, day, neighbours); the arrival day stays routePos = f(day) (index.html:3647)
bronze_age.canon_notes: CONSTRAINT, not a question: queueing must not alter sim output. Moving an arrival day shifts every later W.rng.hist draw (:3738, :3748, :5228), so simDays(400) would depend on how the run was viewed; and an accumulator fed by render frames makes the step count depend on frame rate. Otherwise the IDM steps inside the sim tick at a fixed sim-dt and draws nothing from shared streams. Kanesh karum caravans (10-50 donkeys, traders outside walls) are a real-world analogue, low confidence, not Nimlad canon. 'Cog' is a medieval ship-type already in shipped prose (index.html:3404); do not spread it into new prose

constraints: World gen and sim are a pure function of the seed: W.rng streams only, never Math.random, Date.now or performance.now in sim code
Single file index.html, vanilla JS, three.js r128 via CDN, no build. No 3DTilesRendererJS (needs >=0.167), no BatchedMesh (r170+), no LOD hysteresis (dev-only)
Every InstancedMesh on MAT.world carries instanceColor
Reuse CAM.radius as the single zoom signal
Fog is the R13 seeded function; no new W.weather state
Ship default-off behind a hash key + layers row (R18); notices outside the release (R12)
Bronze-age Nīmlad / Kembar voice; R10 banned words
Agents run no git; never commit index.html mid-workflow
Smoke: #s=epeshu + a procedural seed, simDays(400), zero console errors
Queueing/crowds/clouds are render-only: stateless f(seed, day, neighbours); arrival day stays routePos = f(day) (index.html:3647). No render frame feeds an integration accumulator
Keyed hashes for new randomness: xmur3(seed+class+id+day) -> mulberry32 (R9 pattern). Never draw from W.rng.hist/gen/det (alters the world) or per-frame from W.rng.amb (index.html:7161)
New player-facing words: no 'curfew' (use 'gates shut at the dark hour'); 'cog' exists at index.html:3404 but is not spread; 'market ward' is a code term only
Layer keys: C (watch, :6112), H, L, F, T, G, M (:6108-6114), space, 1-5, Escape are taken; shadows toggle is inert once degradeStep>=3
risks: The post's headline features (signal-obeying traffic, a shadows toggle) are unverified. Do not spec them as Tokyo precedent
New queueing or crowd state changes the sim's output for a seed unless it is render-only f(seed, day, place)
The dark hour is render-time (renderTod), so a sim-side curfew needs its own sim-day derivation
Existing determinism edges: omen eclipse performance.now() (index.html:5328); Math.random in precip, lightning, sheep and hearth. Do not copy them
Street-level detail can trip the one-way fps<42 degrade ladder for the whole app
The near plane at 2 m may z-fight sub-metre detail at R~9 m
Concurrent sim edits can fail Filigree Job 3 gates
Drifted sim anchors in docs/filigree/todo-inputs.json (3694, 3511, 3871, 5831); re-anchor by pattern
Epēshu's districts are labels only; authoring a layout may conflict with canon or the atlas chart
A queue offset that leaks into arrival day, or an accumulator fed by render frames, breaks simDays(400) determinism
Sub-cell street relief on 11.72 m cells can disagree with the grid or invent relief outside EPESHU_HF (R22)
